_notes.apify_skip_reason: No APIFY_TOKEN in the environment (repo ships only .env.example), so the Apify Google Maps actor used by /find-business could not run. GBP-equivalent data was assembled from public sources instead and every field below is labelled with where it came from.

sources.city: bridgeslightingpros.com/contact-us — 'Loganville, GA'; corroborated by the Facebook page ('Bridges Lighting Pros, Loganville') and a Bizapedia GA entity listing for BRIDGES LIGHTING PROS LLC in Loganville, GA
sources.legal_name: Bizapedia search result title 'BRIDGES LIGHTING PROS LLC in Loganville, GA' — the Bizapedia detail page itself is behind a bot check and could not be read, so the registration date and registered agent are unverified
sources.owner: wbridges@ email prefix + LinkedIn (Jaron Johnston, 'Supervisor at Bridges Elite Landscapes / Supervisor at Bridges Lighting Pros')

_notes.rating_deliberately_null: Bridges Lighting Pros has no rating this build could verify. The sister/parent company Bridges Elite Landscapes (bridgeselitelandscapes.com, (770) 828-7571) publishes 4.8 from 118 ratings, and the two share ownership and the wbridges@bridgeselitelandscapes.com address — but that rating belongs to the landscaping entity, not the lighting brand. It is recorded here and NOT written into the generated site, because a review badge on the lighting site would be claiming reviews the lighting brand has not earned.
_notes.contact_page_phone_discrepancy: The /contact-us body lists 770-630-3653, while the header, footer and tel: links on every other page list 770-630-4653. Treated the repeated 770-630-4653 as canonical; flag to the client.
